Now let me update the trace and submit:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "Modules/_xxtestfuzz/fuzzer.c", "function": "fuzz_ast_literal_eval", "line": 1, "var": "data", "code": "PyObject* s = PyUnicode_FromString(data);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are converted to a Python string for parsing"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "Modules/_xxtestfuzz/fuzzer.c", "function": "fuzz_ast_literal_eval", "line": 1, "var": "literal", "code": "PyObject* literal = PyObject_CallOneArg(ast_literal_eval_method, s);", "note": "The string is passed to ast.literal_eval which invokes the Python parser/tokenizer"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "Parser/tokenizer.c", "function": "tok_get_fstring_mode", "line": 2549, "var": "current_tok->curly_bracket_expr_start_depth", "code": "current_tok->curly_bracket_expr_start_depth++;", "note": "Each '{' in the f-string format spec increments the expression depth but the depth counter is reset to -1 for each new f-string mode"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "Parser/tokenizer.c", "function": "tok_get_normal_mode", "line": 2204, "var": "tok_mode_stack_index", "code": "tokenizer_mode *the_current_tok = TOK_NEXT_MODE(tok);", "note": "Each nested f-string '{f\"' pushes a new mode via TOK_NEXT_MODE without checking if the mode stack is full"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "Parser/tokenizer.c", "function": "TOK_NEXT_MODE", "line": 51, "var": "tok_mode_stack[tok_mode_stack_index]", "code": "#define TOK_NEXT_MODE(tok) (&(tok->tok_mode_stack[++tok->tok_mode_stack_index]))", "note": "When tok_mode_stack_index reaches MAXLEVEL (200), the next increment writes past the end of the tok_mode_stack array, causing a buffer overflow"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "Parser/tokenizer.c", "function": "tok_get_normal_mode", "line": 2205, "var": "the_current_tok->kind", "code": "the_current_tok->kind = TOK_FSTRING_MODE;", "note": "Writing to the out-of-bounds tokenizer_mode struct corrupts adjacent memory, leading to a crash"}
]
EOF
echo "Trace updated"
</parameter>
